items.citation_text: North York General Hospital, Year in Review 2021–2022 and Year in Review 2022–2023
items.verbatim_snippet: NYGH’s 2021–2022 Board roster included Cynthia Devine, Sheila Jarvis and Dr. Louise Lemieux-Charles. The subsequent 2022–2023 roster no longer included those three governors, while the remainder of the elected-governor roster was substantially retained.

items.role: President of the Medical Staff Association
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital, Year in Review 2021–2022 and Year in Review 2022–2023
items.verbatim_snippet: In the 2021–2022 governance roster, Dr. Arun Sayal was listed as President of the Medical Staff Association. In the 2022–2023 roster, Dr. Benjamin Bell held that position instead.

items.role: President of the Medical Staff Association
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital, Year in Review 2021–2022 and Year in Review 2022–2023
items.verbatim_snippet: In the 2022–2023 roster, Dr. Benjamin Bell held that position instead. Because the position is an ex-officio connection to the hospital’s governance structure, this represents a medical-leadership change relevant to Board oversight, even though it is not a corporate Board seat.

items.role: Vice President, Corporate Performance & Digital Health Innovation and Chief Financial Officer
items.citation_text: NYGH executive-expense disclosure; SickKids biography; NYGH 2023–2024 Governance and Leadership
items.verbatim_snippet: Young Lee, NYGH’s Vice President, Corporate Performance & Digital Health Innovation and Chief Financial Officer, was still in the role for the reporting period ending May 15, 2023, but later left NYGH for SickKids.

items.role: Interim CFO
items.citation_text: NYGH executive-expense disclosure; SickKids biography; NYGH 2023–2024 Governance and Leadership
items.verbatim_snippet: The 2023–2024 NYGH governance record lists Peter Wegener as Interim CFO, documenting the resulting transition in one of the hospital’s key executive-accountability positions.

items.role: Chair of the Medical Advisory Committee / Chief of Staff
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital, 2023–2024 Governance and Leadership
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. Simon Raphael was the Chair of NYGH’s Medical Advisory Committee and Chief of Staff through the earlier 2022–2023 governance year. The 2023–2024 governance record identifies Dr. Phil Shin as Chair of the Medical Advisory Committee from July 2023 onward, while Raphael is identified as the former chair through July 2023.

items.role: Chair of the Medical Advisory Committee
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital, 2023–2024 Governance and Leadership
items.verbatim_snippet: The 2023–2024 governance record identifies Dr. Phil Shin as Chair of the Medical Advisory Committee from July 2023 onward, while Raphael is identified as the former chair through July 2023. This was a significant physician-governance transition.

items.role: President and CEO
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital Year in Review 2023–2024; University of Toronto Department of Otolaryngology
items.verbatim_snippet: Karyn Popovich retired as President and CEO after a more than 40-year NYGH career, with the 2023–2024 Year in Review identifying her as CEO up to November 2023.

items.role: President and CEO
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital Year in Review 2023–2024; University of Toronto Department of Otolaryngology
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. Everton Gooden, a longtime NYGH surgeon and former medical leader, became President and CEO December 1, 2023. This is the principal CEO succession in the review period and one of the most significant governance transitions at NYGH.

items.role: Board of Governors member
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital, Year in Review 2022–2023 and 2023–2024 Governance and Leadership
items.verbatim_snippet: Robert Palter appears on NYGH’s 2023–2024 Board of Governors roster but not on the 2022–2023 roster. His addition is therefore a documented hospital-board composition change during the 2023–2024 governance cycle.

items.role: Chair of the NYGH Board of Governors
items.citation_text: NYGH governance/fiscal-accountability documentation; Mitch Frazer and Bert Clark public statements
items.verbatim_snippet: Bert Clark completed his three-year term as Chair of the NYGH Board of Governors, and Mitch Frazer succeeded him as Board Chair.

items.role: Board Chair
items.citation_text: NYGH governance/fiscal-accountability documentation; Mitch Frazer and Bert Clark public statements
items.verbatim_snippet: Bert Clark completed his three-year term as Chair of the NYGH Board of Governors, and Mitch Frazer succeeded him as Board Chair. NYGH’s current strategic materials identify Frazer as Chair, while contemporary documentation records the transition as taking effect June 18, 2024.

items.role: Interim CFO
items.citation_text: Boyden / original NYGH appointment announcement
items.verbatim_snippet: Following Peter Wegener’s interim CFO tenure, NYGH appointed Paul Truscott Jr. as Vice President, Finance, Data Analytics & Chief Financial Officer. He was announced on October 16, 2024 and began the position January 6, 2025. NYGH specifically thanked Wegener for his interim financial stewardship and transition support.

items.role: Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive
items.citation_text: Mirams Becker / original NYGH appointment announcement
items.verbatim_snippet: NYGH appointed Terri Stuart-McEwan as Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive, beginning February 11, 2025. The appointment followed her role at Oak Valley Health and represented a significant transition in NYGH’s clinical-services and nursing executive leadership.

items.role: interim Vice President, Medical Affairs, Research and Education
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital
items.verbatim_snippet: NYGH announced Dr. Richard Bowry as its next Vice President, Medical Affairs, Research and Education, effective April 1, 2025. He succeeded the interim arrangement led by Dr. Lloyd Smith, whom NYGH credited with 14 months of interim leadership.

items.role: Vice President, Medical Affairs, Research and Education

items.verbatim_snippet: NYGH announced Dr. Richard Bowry as its next Vice President, Medical Affairs, Research and Education, effective April 1, 2025.

items.role: member of the North York General Board of Governors
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital / North York General Foundation announcement
items.verbatim_snippet: At the June 16, 2025 Annual General Meeting, NYGH announced Paviter (Pavi) Binning, Deputy Chairman and Director of Wittington Investments, as a new member of the North York General Board of Governors.

items.role: Chief Communications and External Relations Officer
items.citation_text: Boyden / original NYGH announcement
items.verbatim_snippet: Serda Evren was appointed NYGH’s next Chief Communications and External Relations Officer, starting January 26, 2026. The role sits on the Senior Leadership Team.

items.role: Board of Governors member
items.citation_text: Mirams Becker, North York General Board appointment announcement
items.verbatim_snippet: NYGH appointed Simone Atungo and Dr. Kathryn Nichol to its Board of Governors in July 2026. The retained-search firm that conducted the appointment process reported the appointments on July 3, 2026 ... Atungo, founder/CEO of Onuera Consulting, and Nichol, President and CEO of VHA Home HealthCare, as the two new governors.
